set.body:
Supporting track of docs/plan.md.

Done when
The owner can run a ten-minute demonstration of the four journeys on the pilot instance, with a recorded fallback, and hand over a brief, a cost table, a pilot proposal, a security overview and statements from two or three investigators.

The argument
It meets the institute's stated needs (the four journeys). It is real (people use it on real data). It costs less and the spending is staged. It is safe enough to pilot (named sign-in, explainable and revocable access, a tested restore, de-identified data). It will last (a small codebase, standard files, a named research-IT partner). Researchers want it (their statements).

Positioning from docs/product-direction.md still holds: Sanctity is the institute's system of record, and Brain-CODE, OpenNeuro or a Dataverse are places a study can be deposited.
set.title: PITCH: Show the Vice-President, Research
